summary: Angry Birds entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Angry Birds
entries.definitive_edition: Red's First Flight on iOS for current official access

emulation.notes: Use real iOS device capture. Android emulation is not primary because the current official Android route is not generally available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current iOS App Store build, or original-device capture if preserved

primary.version: Red's First Flight / Rovio Classics: Angry Birds
primary.why: The original 2009 mobile release has been delisted from normal storefront access, while Rovio's support page says Rovio Classics: Angry Birds remains on the App Store under the name Red's First Flight. That makes the current iOS remake/reissue the best accessible official route, with original installs preserved only if already owned.
primary.how_to_play: Use Red's First Flight on iOS for current official access. If an original 2009-era install/device is available, preserve it separately as historical capture rather than assuming it matches the current App Store build.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically important but generally delisted; use only if already preserved on a device/account.

all_releases.platform: Android / Symbian / web / PC / console ports
all_releases.fidelity: Ports and adaptations of the original mobile hit.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive route over a preserved original or current official remake.

all_releases.platform: Rovio Classics: Angry Birds / Red's First Flight on iOS
all_releases.fidelity: Current official faithful remake/reissue route on the App Store.
all_releases.reason: primary: best accessible official route after Google Play delisting and App Store rename.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The accessible official route is the current iOS remake/reissue, but original-device preservation is still the route for exact 2009 storefront-era behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Rovio support states the remake/reissue was unlisted from Google Play and renamed on the App Store. Record device, app version, and whether the run uses original or remake assets.

entries.title: Bad Piggies
entries.definitive_edition: Current official mobile build or preserved owned mobile install

emulation.notes: Use real touch hardware for primary if possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official mobile build on touch device

primary.version: Current official mobile build if available
primary.why: Bad Piggies is a Rovio-built Angry Birds spin-off designed around touch-friendly vehicle construction. Mobile remains the intended route; PC and other ports are useful only when a preserved mobile build is unavailable.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official iOS/Android build or a preserved owned mobile install. Record app version, device/OS, ad/IAP/offline state, level packs, sandbox progress, and whether PC/Mac ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if mobile availability is poor or for capture comparison.
secondary.why: The game was mobile-first, but PC ports can be easier to preserve.

all_releases.reason: secondary: useful for capture/preservation if mobile builds are unavailable.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Mobile is the intended route, but app availability/version drift may make preserved desktop or owned mobile installs useful.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record app availability, ads/IAP state, and whether the build is current or preserved legacy.

entries.title: Angry Birds Epic
entries.definitive_edition: Legacy iOS/Android installed build with app/server state documented

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if legally sourced build and services work
emulation.notes: Prefer original device capture when possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original mobile device running a retained app build

primary.version: Legacy installed mobile build; no current normal storefront route
primary.why: Angry Birds Epic was a mobile RPG spinoff that has been removed or unlisted from normal mobile storefront access. The practical archive route is a previously installed/owned device build, with online and event features documented as unavailable or uncertain.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally retained iOS/Android install where available. Record OS/device, app version, save/account state, offline availability, Arena/event/server behavior, IAP availability, and whether the build came from a prior purchase/download history.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for platform preservation if a working legacy device/build is available.
secondary.why: iOS/Android were the main routes and are already hard to preserve.

all_releases.fidelity: Original mobile route, currently dependent on legacy install/access.
all_releases.reason: primary: main release family, but delisted/unlisted.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The game is not normally available through current storefronts, and online/live features may not be reproducible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat currently available Angry Birds games as substitutes; Epic is a distinct delisted RPG spinoff.

entries.title: Angry Birds 2
entries.definitive_edition: Current iOS/Android Angry Birds 2 live client

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if supported by the current app/service
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official mobile client on real hardware

primary.version: Current live Angry Birds 2 mobile client
primary.why: Angry Birds 2 remains a live mobile sequel with active events, app-store distribution, IAP, account/progression systems, and rotating content. The current mobile client is the practical archive route, but the exact 2015 launch state is not reproducible.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current iOS or Android client. Record app version, device/OS, account state, event/season, energy/IAP/ad state, flock/hat/progression state, offline behavior, and whether China or regional variants are excluded.

all_releases.fidelity: Current live mobile sequel with active events and app-store distribution.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The live game is current, but launch-era balance, events, and economy cannot be fully reproduced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record live event and app version; do not substitute the original Angry Birds or Rovio Classics route.

entries.title: Angry Birds Space
entries.definitive_edition: Legally retained mobile or PC build with version and unlock state documented

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if legally sourced build works
emulation.notes: Prefer original mobile device or retained PC build.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Retained original build with exact platform/version/unlock state documented

primary.version: Legacy owned build; no normal current storefront route
primary.why: Angry Birds Space is a distinct gravity-focused Angry Birds entry that was removed from many normal storefront routes. Archive capture depends on a retained mobile/PC build, version, IAP/episode unlock state, and whether NASA/Star Wars-adjacent promotional content is available.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally retained iOS/Android/PC build where available. Record platform, app/build version, episode unlocks, IAP/ad state, device/OS, offline behavior, account/save state, and whether later Angry Birds entries were excluded.

secondary.platform: Windows PC / macOS / legacy storefront builds
secondary.what_to_play: Use if legally owned and functional.

all_releases.fidelity: Original mobile gravity-puzzle route, now legacy/delisted dependent.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / macOS / BlackBerry / Windows Phone / console ports
all_releases.fidelity: Legacy platform ports with different availability/capture options.
all_releases.reason: secondary: platform comparison and retained-build route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Current preservation is legacy-build dependent, and episode/IAP/ad states may not be reproducible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Angry Birds 2, Angry Birds Epic, or the original Angry Birds entry.
